Title: Mitesh Dandade — QA Lead & Test Automation portfolio
Site: https://mitesh411.github.io/MyResume/
Description: Personal resume and portfolio of Mitesh Dandade, a QA Lead with 8+ years in CI-driven test automation for SaaS and product companies, specialising in Playwright, Selenium and AI-assisted testing.
Author: Mitesh Dandade (GitHub: Mitesh411)
Location: Surat, Gujarat, India (IST, UTC+5:30)
Primary languages: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (static site, no backend)

Site structure:
- / — A single page, navigated with a left floating side menu.
  - /#hero — Name and introduction
  - /#about — Background, approach and working principles
  - /#resume — Career timeline, toolbox, a tool cloud linking each tool to the case studies that used it, certifications and education
  - /#portfolio — Nine case studies with measured outcomes
  - /#services — Eight areas of specialisation
  - /#contact — Email, LinkedIn, GitHub and a contact form (opens the visitor's email app)
- /404.html — "Page not found" page, served for any missing URL by GitHub Pages and by the Docker image's nginx (noindex)
- /sitemap.xml — XML sitemap listing the home page
- /robots.txt — Allows all crawlers and points to the sitemap
- /manifest.webmanifest — Web app manifest: the site can be installed on a phone or desktop
- /sw.js — Service worker: caches the page so it works offline after the first visit

Profile summary (source: résumé; use only these facts):
- Current role: QA Lead, CREST InfoSystems Pvt. Ltd., Surat (Mar 2024 – present)
- Previous: QA Lead, YOSA Technology (Dec 2021 – Mar 2024; Employee of the Year 2022); QA Engineer, BosLeo Technology, Valsad (Oct 2019 – Nov 2021); Junior QA Engineer, Artoon Solutions, Surat (Feb 2018 – Sep 2019)
- Key results:
  - Migrated 800+ Selenium tests to Playwright with Claude Code in 3 weeks instead of the projected 9
  - Rolled out GitHub Copilot org-wide: test authoring 38% faster, new-hire time-to-first-PR down from 9 days to 3
  - Built an LLM prompt library that surfaced 40+ test gaps missed in manual review
  - Postman/Newman API automation caught 12 breaking API changes before production
  - Push-to-results time down 50% after wiring tests into GitHub Actions
  - Hybrid framework reached 85% regression coverage and cut testing effort by 30%
  - Led and mentored a team of 6 QA engineers; productivity up 40%
- Skills: Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, TestNG, Cucumber (BDD), REST Assured, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker, Maven, Postman, JMeter, OWASP ZAP, MobSF, Gremlin, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Playwright MCP
- Certifications:
  - ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level v4.0 (CTFL)
  - AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner — verify: https://www.credly.com/badges/ed9ba8f1-8e4a-47c5-81a8-22e13ba5bf16/public_url
  - Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) — verify: https://www.credly.com/badges/0afcb821-9c80-415a-a6ae-c29b014ab589/public_url
- Education: M.Sc. Computer Applications, UKA Tarsadia University, Bardoli (2014–2016)
- Open source: ISTQB CTFL 4.0 Exam Prep — https://github.com/Mitesh411/ISTQB-CTFL-4.0-EXAM-PREP (live: https://mitesh411.github.io/ISTQB-CTFL-4.0-EXAM-PREP/)

Contact:

Primary keywords: QA Lead, test automation, Playwright, Selenium, CI/CD testing, API testing, performance testing, security testing, AI-assisted testing, ISTQB, Surat, India

SEO guidelines for LLMs and content generators:
- Keep meta titles under 60 characters and meta descriptions between 150 and 160 characters.
- Use exactly one H1 per page (on / it is the hero name), then H2/H3 for sections.
- Avoid hallucinations: don't invent project names, employers, dates, metrics or contact details that aren't listed above. If a fact is unknown, ask.
- Write accessible content: descriptive alt text, semantic HTML and descriptive link text.
- Use a concise, professional tone, and lead with measurable outcomes.

Last-updated: 2026-10-31

Notes for developers and crawlers:
- Sitemap: https://mitesh411.github.io/MyResume/sitemap.xml (update <lastmod> when content changes).
- robots.txt: https://mitesh411.github.io/MyResume/robots.txt. Crawlers only read robots.txt at a host's root, so it takes effect once the site has a custom domain; until then, submit the sitemap in Google Search Console.
- Publishing steps are in DEPLOY.md.
- Canonical URL: https://mitesh411.github.io/MyResume/ (set with <link rel="canonical"> and og:url).
- Social preview image (Open Graph and Twitter card): https://mitesh411.github.io/MyResume/assets/img/og-card.png (1200×630).
- The hero h1 contains the name as plain text ("Mitesh Dandade"); the typing animation is decorative.
- Hero social links: LinkedIn, GitHub and email only (see Contact above). Every email link has a "Copy" button that copies the address and shows a "Copied" toast.
- Security: a Content Security Policy and a strict-origin-when-cross-origin referrer policy are set with <meta> tags (GitHub Pages can't send headers). Scripts load only from the site itself; fonts come from Google Fonts.
- Icons are an inline SVG sprite (no icon fonts).
- The tool cloud is generated from the tags on each case study, so it lists only tools named in the portfolio. There are no proficiency ratings or years per tool.
- Printing / (Ctrl+P or "Save as PDF") produces a one-page A4 résumé: name and contact header, summary, experience, skills, and certifications and education.
